hooks.name: property-tests-on-save
hooks.description: Run property tests for the saved MCP module; on failure, propose a fix and wait for approval.

action.prompt: The user saved a file under mcp/. Using the module stem (mcp/tools/meter.py gives "meter"), run `pytest tests/properties -q -k <stem>`. If all pass, reply with one line and modify nothing. If any fail, report the failing invariant, the Hypothesis counterexample, and the tool function involved. Then read that tool in mcp/, propose a minimal fix that satisfies the invariant without weakening the test, and show the diff. Stop and wait for my approval before applying anything.
